column1: # The by-hand read decision 0018 section 3 allows for a dimension's escapes ("escapes by hand"): round 10 roster groups that fix an objective bug in a released product version, reported in the window by someone who is no finder seat. Attribution is the evaluator's, from each group's brief; the reviewer attacks it. `owner` is the dimension whose perfect result (0018 section 1) the bug violates, `none` where no brief owns it. `window` is `in` (reported after the round-9 closeout stamp, on a released version), `day0` (dated 2026-10-14, the stamp's own day; the hour is in no tracked record) or `unreleased` (caused and caught inside the window before any release carried it: an injected bug, no escape). `cause_pr` is a merged pull request the group's brief names as the cause, `-` where it names none. Columns are tab-separated.
